pod.description: A PodTemplateSpec. Each incarnation's Pod takes its labels, annotations and spec; the controller adds the state volume. The API server validates the result when the Pod is created.

name.description: The Pod volume the controller fills with the Sandbox's state PVC. The template's containers mount it by this name and must not define it.

claim.description: A PersistentVolumeClaimSpec for the state PVC.
